findings.passage: “Election integrity starts with voter integrity: Only U.S. citizens should vote in American elections,” said Bollin in a release. “However, Michigan doesn’t require voters to do something as simple as show proof of citizenship. By requiring voters to prove their citizenship and present photo ID, this plan will provide commonsense guardrails to protect the integrity of Michigan elections.”
findings.note: Statement in a release issued in her name, reported 13 Mar 2025, supporting House Joint Resolution B (proof of citizenship to register and photo ID to vote). She testified on it before the House Election Integrity Committee on 4 Mar 2025.

findings.passage: “Last year, a Chinese national exploited a gaping loophole in Michigan law to cast a ballot and meddle in our elections,” Bollin said. “He easily voted illegally because he never had to provide proof of citizenship, and his vote counted the same as every legal Michigan voter. We need to close this door and secure our elections so U.S. citizens can vote without illegal ballots canceling theirs out.”
